goal: Prevents nodes from wrongly disconnecting well-behaved peers during IBD when they're busy serving blocks instead of answering pings
Fixes issue #35761 where prioritized block-serving delays pong responses past the timeout
reviewability: Ready to review now, author has actively addressed all feedback through 2026-09-16
No known open material request is unaddressed
agreement: Concept approval without stated concerns beyond initial support (l0rinc)
Concept approval, then detailed review raising edge cases (danielabrozzoni)
Nonblocking objection: m_last_block_time not updating for known blocks could shorten grace period, judged fringe (danielabrozzoni)
Nonblocking objection: ping RPC could mask a due disconnect, accepted as existing unlikely edge case (danielabrozzoni)
Test robustness suggestion was implemented by the author

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it fixes a real bug where honest peers are wrongly disconnected during IBD
Benefits any peer busy serving blocks that would otherwise fail to answer a ping in time
Kept at P2 rather than P1 since other timeout backstops still exist and this is a targeted fix
